description: The tenant's mailboxes, with what each can actually DO: can_read (an IMAP host is configured) and can_send (an SMTP host, or a Gmail account connected by OAuth). Several per tenant are expected — one per customer if that is how the work is divided. Credentials are never returned. When an agent with a mailbox setting (set_agent_mailboxes) is acting, only its mailboxes are listed and its default carries standard=true; all=true lists every mailbox of the tenant. Read-only.

all.description: List every mailbox of the tenant, not only the acting agent's

name: list_mailboxes
